instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). The PR is still in the merge queue, but GitHub cannot merge it until the conflicts are resolved. Choose one path: (a) resolve them now — pushing the updated head removes only this PR from the queue, the other entries stay queued, and this PR must be enqueued again once it is ready; or (b) wait — skip the conflict push step and rerun Shepherd after the polling interval instead of immediately, until GitHub removes the entry itself; this step repeats until then, and an unchanged conflict escalates through `stall-timeout`. To resolve now: Resolve them before committing.
If you chose (a): Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch.
